themezerSupport.status: Actual 3DS/2DS themes and Luma3DS splash pages are present. This is distinct from the Switch NXTheme catalogue.

themezerApp.instructions: CIA installs with FBI. Copy the 3DSX build to SD:/3ds/ and use Homebrew Launcher. Its input folders are SD:/Themes, SD:/Splashes and SD:/Badges; settings/cache use SD:/3ds/themezer-3ds. Its README says it can uninstall current content and automatically enable Luma splashes. Anemone3DS can still scan Themezer QR codes.

anemone.instructions: Copy original ZIPs into SD:/Themes or SD:/Splashes. R scans QR codes using CFW/Rosalina. Theme mode: hold A and release with Up for full install, Right to preserve current BGM, Left for BGM only. Y previews. Splash mode: A installs to /luma; B removes the installed splash. Shuffle uses 2–10 selected themes. Keep a backup before deleting anything.
anemone.formats: Theme ZIPs contain body_LZ.bin; optional bgm.bcstm supplies HOME Menu music. Splash ZIPs contain splash.bin and/or splashbottom.bin. These are separate content types.

lumaSplash.instructions: Hold Select while powering on for Luma configuration. Set Splash to Before or After. Luma reads SD:/luma/splash.bin and SD:/luma/splashbottom.bin. Top and bottom images are 400×240 and 320×240. Set Splash Off to disable display without deleting the files. Splash duration is configurable.

recovery.instructions: If corrupt theme extdata causes a black screen, the official wiki identifies the region theme-management folder under SD:/Nintendo 3DS/<ID0>/<ID1>/extdata/00000000/: USA 000002cd, EUR 000002ce, JPN 000002cc. Back up the SD and exact folder before following the official removal procedure. Do not remove the entire Nintendo 3DS directory.
recovery.themezerFaqPathCaution: Themezer's recovery FAQ omits the second 32-character ID in its displayed path. Prefer the official Anemone wiki's full ID0/ID1 path.

unverified: The theme author pages do not state New-model-only requirements. Do not assert a hardware test.

No explicit minimum system firmware or Korean/Chinese/Taiwan HOME Menu theme support was established by these sources. Require a HOME Menu that actually has the Change Theme option and link current modding guidance; do not recommend a region change solely for themes.
